claims.text: The resort is on a private island surrounded by rainforest and white-sand beaches, overlooking the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: Surrounded by verdant rainforest and white-sand beaches on a private island, The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort overlooks the alluring waves of the Indian Ocean.

claims.text: The resort is on Vommuli Island in Dhaalu Atoll, Maldives.

findings.quote: Vommuli Island, Dhaalu Atoll, Maldives, 13080

claims.text: The resort's library is shaped to swirl upward like a cone shell.

findings.quote: the impressively large library swirls into the sky like a cone shell

claims.text: T-Pan serves modern Japanese kaiseki with limited seating, paired with Dassai sakes.

findings.quote: Experience modern Japanese Kaiseki at T•Pan, an intimate haven with limited seating. Each course showcases seasonal ingredients in perfect harmony, paired with premium Dassai sakes

claims.text: Decanter is a hidden wine cellar offering a fine-dining six-course menu with hand-picked vintages.

findings.quote: This hidden wine cellar offers an intimate fine-dining restaurant experience in the Maldives with hand-picked vintages and a refined six-course menu.

claims.text: The Whale Bar serves Latin-inspired tapas and cocktails at sunset, with a signature Champagne Sabering ritual.

findings.quote: The Whale Bar bursts with South American spirit at sunset. Enjoy Latin-inspired tapas, cocktails, and DJ sets in a lively oceanfront celebration featuring our signature Champagne Sabering Ritual

claims.text: The Blue Hole Pool is a hydrotherapy pool with whirlpool jets on the spa's covered terrace.

findings.quote: Situated on our covered terrace, our Blue Hole Pool is one of the most expansive hydrotherapy pools in the Maldives. An array of whirlpool jets melt away tension

claims.text: The dive and watersports centre reaches over 40 dive sites around the atoll, and the house reef is good for snorkeling.

findings.quote: With over 40 distinguished dive sites encircling the atoll, our Vommuli Dive & Watersports Centre opens a world of manta glides, reef gardens, and cerulean depths. Along our vibrant house reef, serene snorkeling

claims.text: Bicycles are provided for every villa.

findings.quote: With bicycles provided for every villa

claims.text: The complimentary Children's Club is monitored at all times by professional childcare attendants.

findings.quote: The club is monitored at all times by professional childcare attendants.

claims.text: Garden Villas sit within the island's jungle canopy and each has a private pool.

findings.quote: our 150 sqm (1,614 sqft) Garden Villas offer a rare, secluded immersion within the island's lush jungle canopy. Featuring a King bed, a private pool

claims.text: The John Jacob Astor Estate has a cinema room, a private gym and a dedicated space for spa treatments.

findings.quote: Inside, the villa features a state-of-the-art cinema room, a fully equipped private gym, and a dedicated space for personalized spa treatments

claims.text: Overwater villas are shaped like manta rays and built mainly from cross laminated wood instead of traditional thatch.

findings.quote: Instead of the traditional thatched bungalows, overwater villas here are shaped like manta rays and made from predominantly cross laminated wood

claims.text: The Whale Bar sits over the Indian Ocean and is shaped to resemble a whale shark.

findings.quote: sitting over the Indian Ocean and shaped to resemble a whale shark

claims.text: Visits to the overwater Iridium Spa begin in the Iridium Room, where guests sip Iridium tea while watching marine life through glass floors.

findings.quote: Each visit begins in our serene Iridium Room, where guests sip Iridium tea while watching vibrant marine life through glass floors.
award-winning wellness at our overwater spa in the Maldives

claims.text: Norma, the resort's private yacht, was inspired by Nourmahal, the yacht of John Jacob Astor IV, and is designed for up to eight guests.

findings.quote: Inspired by Nourmahal, the beloved yacht of John Jacob Astor IV, Norma embodies the spirit of refined adventure and indulgence. Designed for up to eight guests
Cruise the Indian Ocean aboard Norma, our elegantly appointed private yacht

claims.text: The resort has partnered with Reefscapers on coral reef restoration since 2023.

findings.quote: Through our partnership with Reefscapers since 2023, The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort is committed to protecting and nurturing local coral reefs.

claims.text: Resort transfers are mandatory: a round-trip shared seaplane transfer of about 45 minutes from the airport.

findings.quote: Resort transfers mandatory: The round-trip shared seaplane transfer fee is USD 870 per person, (approx. 45 minutes from the airport).

claims.text: Guests on flights arriving after 3:30 PM must stay overnight in Male.

findings.quote: For flights arriving after 3:30 PM, an overnight stay in Male’ is required.

claims.text: The resort is not technically wheelchair accessible, though it takes steps to make stays as easy as possible.

findings.quote: While it is not technically a wheelchair-accessible resort, the hotel will take necessary steps to make it as easy as possible for guests.
